newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia pipeline to ship gas to Plutonic mine.
newsitem.headline: Australia pipeline to ship gas to Plutonic mine.

text.p: Goldfields Gas Transmission Pty Ltd (GGT) said it has secured a three-year contract to transport 3.4 terajoules a day of natural gas to the Plutonic Resources Ltd gold mine in Western Australia starting in the third quarter of 1997.
The gas will be transported 703 km from Yarmoola to Three Rivers for consumption at a new power station to be built at the mine, GGT said.
The contract also includes an option to extend the arrangement for up to a further 13 years, GGT said.
This is the second third party gas transmission contract for the pipeline and discussions are well advanced with a number of other prospective pipeline users, GGT said.
The pipeline is a joint venture between miners WMC Ltd (62.664 percent), The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (11.843 percent) and Gold Mines of Kalgoorlie Ltd, 25.493 percent).
The 1,380-km pipeline is designed to carry gas from fields offshore northwestern Western Australia to the state's eastern goldfields.
